name: DREDD

tenures.source: Formed on air by John Doe and Jonathan Marx, who turn on the match referee together and declare themselves dedicated to taking the World Heavyweight Championship from Jean Rabesque, on the 24 August 2004 RAUCOUS; joined from the outset by Marx's own manager Brandon Jacobs, and by Carlee Marx (billed as Jane Doe until her own amnesia lifts) by the 28 December 2004 RAUCOUS, where she wrestles under DREDD's own banner.

caption: New ERA of Wrestling's anti-Jean-Rabesque stable, formed on air by John Doe and Jonathan Marx after turning on a referee together.
notes: Karla Starr is invited to join and accepts on air (28 September 2004) but never wrestles under the stable's own banner and turns on both Chaos and Jean Rabesque the same night; she is not counted a genuine member here.

identity.note: Name collision only: a wrestler billed 'Judge Dredd' (after the comic book character) is already held at an unrelated early-1990s wing (summit-of-e-wrestling/ufws); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence ties that single wrestler to this wing's own 2004 stable.
